transformationPolicy: Preserve source coordinates and all nonduplicate oriented triangles through glTF import/export axis conversion. Documented exception: Blender mesh validation automatically removes 18 duplicate-index faces (RA 12, LM 5, SVC 1), retaining exactly one original winding per duplicate-index group. Selected source triangles 267360 become 267342 output triangles with zero observed coordinate deviation; 835 zero-area faces remain (RA 812, LM 6, SVC 17). This is not anatomical repair or approval. No non-uniform scaling, reconstruction, smoothing, decimation or invented anatomy. Do not apply HRA graph ontology local-placement rotations to GLB vertices.
